name: COMMVAULT SYSTEMS INC
business: Sells cyber-resilience software and SaaS for enterprise data backup, recovery and ransomware protection to businesses and government agencies worldwide.

events.what: CFO appointed (rehire of former CFO 2022 to 2024, Chief Commercial Officer since August 2024); Jennifer DiRico resigned as CFO effective 2025-12-31 (8-K 0001169561-25-000094)
President of Customer and Field Operations appointed (resigned as director 2026-04-08)
Director appointed and named Chairperson of the board's Operating Committee
events.from: Intapp (EVP and CFO); previously CFO of DigiCert, Anaplan, Seagate

events.what: No CEO change: Sanjay Mirchandani CEO since February 2019

next_event.source: Merrill, William Blair conference 2026-06-02, document_id 55998: no long-term operating margin target 'yet', working on a long-term algorithm 'at some point'; no date or investor day announced

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: Company guides non-GAAP EBIT margin (one-year: FY2027 about 21%, raised 50 bps from 20.5%). Gap uses VA consensus non-GAAP operating margin (Operating income, Primary), same metric. Baba FY2027 equals company fiscal 2027 ending 2027-03-31 (March FYE, both keyed to the year end). No long-term target.

statements.quote: In addition, for fiscal 2027, we are increasing our full year non-GAAP EBIT margin guidance by 50 basis points to approximately 21%.
statements.speaker: Gary Merrill
statements.doc_title: COMMVAULT SYSTEMS INC Q1 2027 Earnings Call

statements.quote: Non-GAAP EBIT grew to $71 million, representing a Non-GAAP EBIT margin of 22.8%, a 210 basis point improvement year over year. This was our best quarterly EBIT margin performance in over a decade
statements.speaker: Gary Merrill
statements.doc_title: COMMVAULT SYSTEMS INC Q1 2027 Earnings Call

statements.quote: Do you have a long-term target for operating margin? We do not yet. I'm just back in the CFO role now for a month. I think one of the priorities will be to work through that to get that long-term algorithm here at some point.
statements.speaker: Gary Merrill
statements.doc_title: 46th Annual William Blair Growth Stock Conference

street.gap_assumption: FY2027 non-GAAP EBIT margin guide about 21% minus VA consensus FY2027 operating margin (Primary) 20.45%; same metric. FY2026 EBITDA margin is reported (year ended 2026-03-31). VA EBITDA margins shown are a different, D&A-inclusive basis.

evidence_of_progress.note: Order [Q4 FY2026 (March 2026), Q1 FY2027 (June 2026)]. Q4 is VA EBITDA margin YoY; Q1 FY2027 (not yet in VA actuals) is the CFO's stated non-GAAP EBIT margin +210 bps to 22.8% (doc 107401). Q2 FY2027 EBIT margin guided to about 20%.

verdict: Weak match: CFO rehire, new field president and a CFO-heavy director chairing a new Operating Committee, but the stock is not cheap (21.5x EBITDA, 58th percentile), the CEO is seven years in, and framing is a one-year 21% EBIT guide only 55 bps above consensus.
open_questions: What is the board's new Operating Committee under David Morton mandated to do, and does it signal a margin or cost program?
When will Merrill publish the long-term margin algorithm he said Commvault does not have yet?
Is the Q1 FY2027 22.8% EBIT margin sustainable given the guided step down to about 20% in Q2?
